correctness_confidence.basis: I re-encoded the problem (pair counts 37 and 1489 match the paper) and ran CaDiCaL 1.5.3: SAT at (r=2,N=53) and (r=3,N=773) with witnesses verified, UNSAT at 54 and 774. Monotonicity and r=1 arguments are correct. UNSAT proofs not checked.

rigor.basis: Encoding is sound; claims are honestly graded (Table 1). UNSAT rests on solver outputs and a self-written, unverified RUP checker; no LRAT/cake_lpr; Lean search has no link theorem to the formal-conjectures definition. Candid about these gaps.

novelty.basis: Exact small values of N_0(2), N_0(3) for a listed open problem; author disclaims priority after a limited literature search. Method is routine SAT; I did not search the literature, so novelty is unchecked.

significance.basis: A small computational datum, explicitly not progress on the asymptotic question (Green-Sawhney exp exp(r^50) bound). Gives concrete benchmarks and shows the interval construction is far from sharp for small r, but yields no conclusions for large r.

reproducibility.basis: Problem is tiny and fully specified: encoding, witnesses in appendix, my from-scratch rerun took seconds. Supplement, Lean files and proof checker were not available to me, so those parts are unverified.

summary: The note determines N_0(1)=9, N_0(2)=54, N_0(3)=774 for the least N forcing a monochromatic {x+y, xy} (x,y>=3, x=y allowed) in any r-colouring of [1,N]. Lower bounds are explicit colourings; upper bounds come from SAT unsatisfiability. My independent CaDiCaL rerun with my own encoding reproduces all four thresholds (53 colourable, 54 not; 773 colourable, 774 not). The claims are modest, honestly graded and disclose AI authorship and the absence of formal proofs. Main residual weaknesses are unverified UNSAT certificates and unchecked novelty.
strengths: Precise definition and sound reduction; monotonicity and r=1 cases correct.
Thresholds independently reproduced by me from a fresh encoding (SAT/UNSAT as claimed).
Honest evidence-strength table and explicit 'what is not done' and AI-assistance disclosure.
Witnesses printed in the appendix; checks with multiple solvers, two encodings and negative tests of the proof checker.
weaknesses: UNSAT upper bounds are not formally certified: custom unverified RUP checker, no LRAT or verified checker, no Lean proof of unsatisfiability.
No theorem links the Lean exists_col search to the formal-conjectures definition of N_0.
Literature search for prior values was limited; no priority claim.
Minimal mathematical content and no insight into large r or structure of extremal colourings; N_0(4) not computed.
A spurious 'found falsified original clause' message from the PySAT CaDiCaL wrapper was dismissed without an explanation.
potential_errors: Appendix witness strings could contain transcription errors relative to the checked files; I did not recheck the printed strings.
The statement that the stricter x>y>2 variant gives the same values for r=2,3 was not verified by me (only r=1 value 12 checked by hand).
The 2132-lemma DRUP proof validity rests on an unaudited 70-line checker; claims about Lean timings and versions are unverified by me.
